findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "fresh402_register" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Create or retrieve a free Fresh402 baseline and persistent watch_id. Existing baselines are returned without refetching, so this tool cannot be used as a free repeated change check." → after: "Observes public content without modifying its source. Adds a Fresh402 baseline and uses free registration capacity for new watches; never charges USDC or credits. Use free ($0) Register to save a public HTTPS baseline; no trial key, wallet or payment. Required url plus optional content/attribute rul"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
